name: SEC Championship Game

tieIns.notes: Top two teams in the standings

notes: The 24-team CFP eliminates Power 4 title games from 2027. ESPN receives ~$140M a year in rebates across the SEC, ACC and Big 12 games, and Fox ~$50M a year from the Big Ten (single-outlet reporting). These rebates are the best public proxy for each game's media value.
revenueNotes: Media value roughly $45-60M a year, inside ESPN's ~$140M rebate for 3 games, plus a ~70k-seat gate and sponsorship worth roughly $15-25M more (estimate). Atlanta contract reportedly runs into the 2030s, so ending the game creates a venue-contract renegotiation (event hook).
note: The sponsor, tie-ins and payout come from researcher knowledge of the 2020-25 cycle and 2025-26 bowl season. The 2026-31 cycle changes were not verified this session.
